a strategic partnership with U.S.-based The Elmet Group, including a 4.99% equity investment in MSR at an implied US$2.5B valuation.
The partnership includes 8+ years of committed tungsten volumes, with MSR supplying ~1,250 tonnes of WO₃-equivalent annually.
The agreements are expected to generate ~US$1.5B in aggregate gross revenue for MSR over the initial term at prevailing tungsten prices.
Masan Group will remain MSR’s controlling shareholder with ~87.46% ownership following the transaction.
The partnership aims to strengthen MSR’s access to U.S. strategic-materials and advanced-manufacturing supply chains, including semiconductors, aerospace and energy.

title: Masan High-Tech Materials partners with Elmet in Tungsten deal
